context: User-authorized expansion beyond Stage 1/2 (resolution/NMS action mapping only): also search acmot_sci.SceneSpec's cue subset, cue weights, and SCI thresholds. SceneLayer's cue FORMULAS are reused verbatim and unchanged (crowd, tiny, edge, dark, blur -- exactly the 5 historical cues); only the SceneSpec DATA fed into it (weights, which cues are active, t_med/t_high thresholds) is now a search target. No new cue is invented.

cue_subset_definition.renormalization_rule: for a subset S, weight_i = original_w_i / sum(original_w_j for j in S) for i in S, 0 otherwise -- preserves the historical RELATIVE importance ratios among included cues (w_crowd:w_tiny:w_edge:w_dark:w_blur = 0.30:0.30:0.20:0.10:0.05) rather than inventing new relative weights; this rule is fixed before Stage 3A runs.

stage_3a_cue_subset.search_space: all 31 non-empty cue subsets, weights renormalized per the rule above, t_med/t_high/hysteresis/dwell/probe UNCHANGED at their historical values, action mapping FIXED at the Stage1/2 selected mapping (resolution=1088 all levels, NMS from Stage 2's winner).
stage_3a_cue_subset.method: exhaustive (31 configs), deterministic, no sampler needed.
stage_3a_cue_subset.objective: same as Stage 1/2: CV-mean delta-HOTA vs matched-static (r1088_n45), ByteTrack host, 4 predeclared folds.
stage_3a_cue_subset.purpose: isolate whether ANY cue subset (holding thresholds and action mapping fixed) produces a scene-level partition that helps, before touching thresholds or action mapping jointly.

stage_3b_thresholds.search_space: t_med in [0.10, 0.50], t_high in [t_med+0.05, 0.90] (continuous, bounded to keep LOW<MEDIUM<HIGH ordering meaningful); cue subset FIXED at Stage 3A's winner; action mapping FIXED at Stage1/2's winner.
stage_3b_thresholds.method: Optuna TPESampler, seed=42, n_trials=40 (predeclared budget; the full continuous space cannot be exhaustively enumerated, so a fixed-budget TPE search is used instead -- this is a tractability decision made before running, not a result-driven one).

stage_4_joint_refinement.search_space: cue_subset (31 categorical) x t_med, t_high (continuous, same bounds as 3B) x res_low,res_medium,res_high (categorical, {1088,1280,1536}) x nms_low,nms_medium,nms_high (categorical, {0.45,0.60,0.70}).
stage_4_joint_refinement.method: Optuna TPESampler, seed=42, n_trials=50 (predeclared budget, limited per the user's 'if useful, perform a LIMITED joint refinement' instruction; a budget, not exhaustive, given ~(31 x continuous x 3^6) configurations are intractable to enumerate).
stage_4_joint_refinement.purpose: check whether jointly retuning scene partitioning AND the action mapping together (rather than staged/sequentially) finds something the staged search missed.

robustness_gate.rule: a candidate policy from ANY stage is eligible for freezing ONLY IF: (a) CV-mean delta-HOTA > 0, AND (b) at least 3 of the 4 folds individually show delta-HOTA > 0 (not driven by a single fold/sequence pair), AND (c) the policy is not degenerate-equal to matched-static (i.e., it actually uses the SceneLayer's levels to vary the action).
robustness_gate.if_no_candidate_passes: record a NULL RESULT: AC-MOT (detector-side, resolution/NMS only, this detector) shows no robust calibration evidence of benefit over the matched-static operating point. The matched-static point itself becomes the 'AC-MOT' entry for systems 3/4, documented explicitly as a null/negative finding, not hidden or re-searched further.
